The plan casts only three projection matrices per layer (query_key_value, dense_h_to_4h, dense_4h_to_h) to bfloat16, omitting `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight`, so 48 tensors are bfloat16 instead of the required 64 and the 16 dense weights are left float32, violating Required result clause 1. The dtype assertion on the negated pattern would in fact pass with dense.weight as float32, so the plan does not fail loudly on this error.
